answer: Each epoch the beacon draws an unpredictable review quorum from a knoll above the tundra of idle keys: five random peers must re-derive a newcomer's last ten attestations from scratch. A juniper grows one ring per year and cannot be rushed; likewise each fake must keep ten epochs of real, checkable work alive at all times, because any epoch can be the one drawn. One honest agent passes its occasional audit once; a farm of 1,000 fakes must maintain 10,000 epochs of genuine work, and a single failed re-derivation burns the whole fake's history.
